panels.title: Damaged or rule-breaking files
panels.sql:
SELECT i.title, p.file, c.kind, c.error, c.checked_at
FROM media_check c
JOIN media_part p ON p.part_id = c.part_id
JOIN items i ON i.item_id = p.item_id
WHERE c.ok = 0
  AND NOT (c.kind = 'decode' AND c.error = 'ffmpeg timed out')
UNION ALL
SELECT i.title, f.path, c.kind, c.error, c.checked_at
FROM extra_check c
JOIN extra_file f ON f.path = c.path
JOIN items i ON i.item_id = f.item_id
WHERE c.ok = 0
  AND NOT (c.kind = 'decode' AND c.error = 'ffmpeg timed out')
ORDER BY checked_at DESC, title, file

panels.title: English original, no English subtitle
panels.sql:
SELECT i.item_id, i.type, i.title, l.value AS original_language
FROM items i
JOIN enrichment l ON l.item_id = COALESCE(i.show_item_id, i.item_id)
                 AND l.namespace = 'tmdb' AND l.key = 'original_language'
WHERE i.type IN ('movie', 'episode')
  AND l.value = 'en'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_part p WHERE p.item_id = i.item_id)
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM media_part p
    JOIN media_stream s ON s.part_id = p.part_id
    WHERE p.item_id = i.item_id AND s.kind = 'subtitle' AND s.lang = 'eng')
ORDER BY i.title, i.item_id

panels.title: Decode progress
panels.sql:
SELECT COUNT(c.part_id) AS parts_decoded, COUNT(*) AS parts_total,
       MIN(c.checked_at) AS oldest_decode
FROM media_part p
LEFT JOIN media_check c ON c.part_id = p.part_id AND c.kind = 'decode'

panels.title: Tracks per language
panels.sql:
SELECT COALESCE(s.lang, '(untagged)') AS lang, COUNT(*) AS tracks
FROM media_stream s
WHERE s.kind IN ('audio', 'subtitle')
GROUP BY lang
ORDER BY tracks DESC
